response.sql: WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS avg_per_day FROM film GROUP BY rating), across_ratings AS (SELECT AVG(avg_per_day) AS overall_avg_per_day FROM per_rating) SELECT AVG(pr.avg_per_day) AS avg_per_day, AVG(pr.avg_per_day - ar.overall_avg_per_day) AS avg_excess FROM per_rating AS pr CROSS JOIN across_ratings AS ar WHERE pr.avg_per_day > ar.overall_avg_per_day
